verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Expensify has its own card product (the 'Expensify Card' in the Collect pricing update) and advertises 'Smart Limits on cards'. That suggests card-level spend controls, but it is only a thin, glancing mention. The BYOC and import-existing-cards items are about bringing other issuers' cards, not issuing them, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of issuing both physical and virtual cards, evidence that each card can carry its own individual limit, evidence that issuance takes minutes, any detailed docs on card issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
